title: Innovative Non-Pharmacological Therapies for Cognitive Impairment: The Role of the Soundcool System
content: Soundcool is a modular and flexible computer software system created for the reali-zation of collaborative live multimedia projects. The system is composed of audio and video modules that work on personal computers. The modules are simple and easy to control: audio and video players, audio effects such as delay, pitch transpos-ing, filters, and video effects such as delay, color transformation, video blending, etc. These simple modules can be interconnected to build substantial collaborative mul-timedia projects. Originally, the main application of the system was education with Project Based Learning (PBL) and Science and Technology, Engineering, Science, Arts and Mathematics (STEAM) education. To enable collaboration, the individual mod-ules were originally controlled over local Wi-Fi using smartphone and tablet apps. During the pandemic, the system was adapted to work over the internet in distribut-ed performances using video conferencing. After the pandemic, this network perfor-mance capability has found very practical application in remote therapies for pa-tients with cognitive disorders, allowing participation in public performances by pa-tients with limited mobility. In this paper we describe the remote collaborative ap-proach of Soundcool and different experiences with network performances for neu-rodegenerative diseases and results.
